# `governance.phase`

governance · phase

the rule-governance phase switch. BUILD = ontology CRUD permitted and a missing lock is GREEN; TUNE = default-DENY, where any un-blessed delta reds the gate and the agent PROPOSES rather than edits. Only the operator flips it. A bundle sitting in BUILD is not governed, and that is a fact worth being able to read mechanically.
